title: fix(platform-objects): the OAuth register form offers only Web and Native, and its Redirect URLs help states the rule for each type
body:
Part of #24773: half 2b, the Console form's part of the maintainer's ruling D (`6293344532`). Half 1 landed as #24853. Half 2a (the `plugin-auth` register wrapper forwards the type as `application_type`) landed as #24992 (`fbb42d900`), which is merged into this branch. The 19.0 refusal of `user-agent-based` / `public` stays on the card.

Clause-②: no (a form's offering: the register route still accepts every type value it accepted, and nothing on the server reads the action's param options, so no accept set or served shape moves)

**Cross-lane:** `packages/platform-objects` is `domain:engine`. This PR comes from the `domain:services` seat 2 under the claim's widened half-2b block (`6302570331`).

**The help describes the door as #24992 left it.** The new Redirect URLs help says a Native application may use `http://localhost`. Before #24992 that was false: the route sent `type`, which the provider drops, so a Native client was judged as Web. Measured both ways on a live showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, `OS_OIDC_PROVIDER_ENABLED=1`, seeded admin), through `POST /api/v1/auth/sys-oauth-application/register`:

| Registration | At `2dc07452a` (without #24992) | At `fd686be8e` (with #24992) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Native + `http://localhost:4001/callback` | 400 `OAUTH_REGISTER_FAILED`, "web clients require https redirect URIs on non-loopback hosts" | 200, stored `native` |
| Native + `http://127.0.0.1:4001/callback` | not run | 200, stored `native` |
| Native + `http://[::1]:4001/callback` | not run | 200, stored `native` |
| Web + `http://localhost:4001/callback` | 400, same refusal | 400, same refusal |
| Web + `https://app.example.com/callback` | 200, stored `web` | 200, stored `web` |
| `user-agent-based` + https | 200, stored `web` | 200, stored `web`, one server warning |
| `public` + https | 200, stored `web` | 200, stored `web`, one server warning |

## What changes

`sys_oauth_application.create_oauth_application` (Setup › OAuth Applications › Register), in `sys-oauth-application.object.ts`:

| | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Application Type options | Web, Native, User-agent based, Public | Web, Native (default Web, still required) |
| Redirect URLs help | "One URL per line. Must use https:// in production." | "One URL per line. Web applications need https:// on a host other than localhost or another loopback address. Native applications may also use http:// on exactly localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1], on any port." |
| Application Type help | none | "Choose Native for a desktop or mobile app, or for an app in local development that redirects to http://localhost." |

- The four `objects.generated.ts` bundles were regenerated with `pnpm i18n:extract`. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values of the two help texts were translated by hand, then extract was run again: the source-hash companions end unchanged, because the new leaves are translations, not copies.
- Not changed: the stored `type` select (`:449` at this head, `:425` at `4b8f597ba`), the `public` boolean column, the register route, and every other line of the file.

## Stop condition: does anything on the server refuse a value the form no longer offers? No.

Measured on the same live showcase at `2dc07452a`, and the register-route rows again at `fd686be8e` (table above):

- `POST /api/v1/auth/sys-oauth-application/register` with `type: 'user-agent-based'` and with `type: 'public'` (https redirect): both `200`, `success: true`.
- The generic action door, `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_oauth_application/create_oauth_application` with `type: 'user-agent-based'`: `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, "is `type: 'api'` — it dispatches on `target`, not through the action registry". The same answer for `type: 'web'` (control). The door refuses an `api` action by its type before its param contract runs (`headlessActionTypeError` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/actions.ts`, ahead of `enforceActionParams`). The MCP `run_action` door refuses it the same way (`isHeadlessInvokableAction`, `action-execution.ts`).
- Source reading: the register route reads `body.type` from the raw request and never reads the object's metadata. The middleware seam hands middleware no body. Nothing else matches an action's `target`.
- So only the form changes. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_oauth_application` now serves the `type` param with options `["web", "native"]` and the new help texts. With `?locale=zh-CN` it serves the zh-CN texts and options `Web 应用` / `原生应用`.

## The rule the help states, measured on the provider

`@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.3, `validateClientRedirectUri` (`dist/authorize-9whjxVLJ.mjs:1685`). #24992's pins cover Web + `http://localhost` refused, Web + https accepted, Native + `http://localhost:4001` and `http://127.0.0.1:4001` accepted, and Native + `http://127.0.0.2:4001` and `http://app.example.com` refused. The rest of what the help says was measured live through the provider's own `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth2/create-client`, at `2dc07452a`:

| application_type | redirect URI | Answer |
|:--|:--|:--|
| native | `http://[::1]:4001/callback` | 201, stored `native` |
| native | `http://localhost:59999/callback` | 201 (any port) |
| native | `http://127.0.0.1/callback` (no port) | 201 |
| native | `https://app.example.com/callback` | 201 (Native also takes what Web takes) |
| native | `https://localhost:4001/callback` | 400 `invalid_redirect_uri`, "native clients must not use https loopback redirect URIs" |
| native | `http://127.0.0.2:4001/callback` | 400, "may use http only on the exact loopback hosts localhost, 127.0.0.1, or [::1]" |
| web | `https://localhost:4001/callback` | 400, "web clients require https redirect URIs on non-loopback hosts" |
| web | `https://127.0.0.1:4001/callback` | 400, same |
| web | `https://app.example.com/callback` | 201 |

The help does not mention Native private-use URI schemes, which the rule also allows. Nothing here measured them through the route.

## The stored columns, measured (for the 19.0 card)

- **What 1.7.3 writes to `type`.** Only `web` or `native`. `checkOAuthClient` refuses any other `application_type` (`:1770`). One more case: a client-metadata-document registration that names no `application_type` stores `null` (`:1956`). Live, at `2dc07452a`: the registrations above named `user-agent-based` and `public` were stored `type: 'web'`, `token_endpoint_auth_method: 'client_secret_basic'` (8 rows read through `GET /api/v1/data/sys_oauth_application`). Again at `fd686be8e`: 6 rows, the same columns.
- **What 1.7.3 writes to `public`.** Never. The client record has no such field (`OAUTH_CLIENT_RECORD_FIELD_NAMES`, `:1034`). No row carries a `public` value (8 at `2dc07452a`, 6 at `fd686be8e`). A public client is `token_endpoint_auth_method: 'none'`.
- **What the stored `type` select actually declares.** The values are `web`, `native`, `useragentbased`, `public`. The column uses `Field.select`'s string-array shorthand, which snake-cases each value and strips the hyphens. So the third declared value has never been `user-agent-based`: not the value the form's action param sent, and not the one the provider's earlier lines accepted (from the SDK and dynamic registration, for public clients). A row holding `user-agent-based` is already outside the declared set today. Keeping the column four-valued in 18.x protects `public`, not `user-agent-based`. The pin below holds the column exactly as declared. Fixing it, or narrowing it, is the 19.0 card's decision.

## Tests

New `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/oauth-register-form-types.test.ts`, 7 cases. It reads the object and the four bundles from source.

- The `type` param is a required select, defaults to `web`, and offers exactly `web` and `native`. Every shipped locale's options are exactly `web` and `native`.
- The Redirect URLs help names `https://`, `http://`, `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `[::1]`. The Application Type help names Native and `http://localhost`.
- The en bundle mirrors the source. Every locale's help names the same scheme and hosts, and each translated locale differs from the English source.
- The stored `type` select still declares its four options (labels `web`, `native`, `user-agent-based`, `public`; values as measured above). The `public` column is still a declared boolean.

Results at `2dc07452a`. `packages/platform-objects` and this PR's changeset are byte-identical at `fd686be8e`: the second merge brought only #24992's three `plugin-auth` / changeset files.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 83 passed (83)`, `Tests 1239 passed (1239)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 1 file / 3 errors / 2 pinned signatures held. No debt added. The new file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`, 1 hit).

## Ablation (one-shot; no permanent file)

Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, in a runner with its own EXIT/INT/TERM trap. Each anchor hit once and fell 1 → 0, with the blob changed on disk. Each restore was verified as blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty (object `240ded11b`, zh-CN bundle `5326f33a2`). The test reads source, so no `dist` is involved.

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A | `{ label: 'User-agent based', value: 'user-agent-based' }` put back on the action's `type` options | 1 failed: `expected [ 'web', 'native', 'user-agent-based' ] to deeply equal [ 'web', 'native' ]` |
| B | Redirect URLs help back to "Must use https:// in production." | 2 failed: the source help no longer names `http://`; the en bundle no longer mirrors the source |
| C | stored `type` select narrowed to `['web', 'native']` | 1 failed: the stored-column pin |
| D | zh-CN help back to its old translation | 1 failed: `zh-CN redirectURLs help ... to contain 'http://'` |
| E | `public: "公共客户端"` put back in zh-CN's action options | 1 failed: `zh-CN type options: expected [ 'web', 'native', 'public' ]` |
| F | Application Type help deleted | 2 failed: the source help pin and the en-mirror pin |
| G | `public` column renamed `is_public` | 1 failed: `expected undefined to be 'boolean'` |
| control | unmutated | 7 passed |

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the final head `fd686be8e` derived 66 commands for 7 paths (208 changed lines, +185 / -23, under the 3000 human-merge threshold). Each ran as `cmd > log 2>&1; rc=$?`, after a workspace build (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`).

- **Result.** 66/66 exit 0, among them `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` ("this PR adds no declared-breaking changeset"), `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:i18n` ("all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys"), `check:i18n-stale-fill` ("0 stale-fill leaf/leaves"), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:closing-keyword-parity`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:type-check-debt` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.
- **Reconciliation.** `--ran` with every exit code recorded: `Run reconciliation — 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- The same 66 also ran at `2dc07452a`, before #24992 was merged in: 66/66 exit 0, reconciled the same way.
- **Not run locally.** `test:repo` is CI's `Test Core`. `check:skill-frame-freshness` does not apply: no frame file is touched. `check:dev-prereqs` passed as the first step of each `pnpm dev` boot. No exported symbol was renamed or removed, so `check-platform-checklist --changed-from` does not apply. The workspace type-check lanes and the CI jobs that `dispatch-gates` lists outside the 66 are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **For the 19.0 card.** The stored-column readings above: 1.7.3 writes `web` / `native` (or `null` for a metadata-document client) to `type` and never writes `public`. The declared third value is `useragentbased`, not `user-agent-based`.
- **`Field.select`'s string shorthand strips hyphens from values** (spaces become underscores; a hyphen is dropped). Measured from built `dist`: `sys_oauth_application.type` declares `useragentbased`. `sys_metadata_audit.lock_state` (`packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-audit.object.ts:190`) declares `nooverlay` / `nodelete`, while its writer (`recordMetadataAudit`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) writes `no-overlay` / `no-delete`. That column is `readonly: true`, so the record validator judges only its shape and the audit writes are not refused. Source reading only; no wrong answer was measured through a door. Reported to the seat in the dev report, not filed here.
